title: Compositional Synthetic Controls
abstract: arXiv:2607.16991v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When applying synthetic control to compositional outcomes (budget, vote shares), researchers commonly minimize Euclidean distances between raw shares. I propose constructing synthetic controls in Aitchison geometry, using centered log-ratio coordinates to select donor weights and form counterfactuals. This approach respects proportional comparisons and is exactly invariant to common multiplicative changes in relative odds. Under a multinomial-choice model, its weights summarize similarity in relative utility indices. Monte Carlo simulations, including a CES allocation model, show that this method performs better when relative incentives determine shares. An application to U.S. school finance demonstrates that this choice can alter reported inference.

translated_abstract: 当将合成控制法应用于成分型结果（如预算、选票份额）时，研究者通常最小化原始份额之间的欧几里得距离。本文提出在Aitchison几何中构建合成控制，使用中心化对数比坐标来选择供体权重并构建反事实结果。这种方法尊重比例间的比较，并对相对几率的共同乘性变化具有严格不变性。在多项选择模型下，其权重能够概括相对效用指数的相似性。蒙特卡洛模拟（包括CES配置模型）表明，当相对激励决定份额时，该方法表现更优。在美国学校财政的应用中，这一方法选择能够改变所报告的统计推断结果。
tldr: 提出在Aitchison几何中使用中心化对数比坐标构建合成控制法，以更合理地处理成分型结果（如预算、选票份额），当相对激励决定份额时，该方法比传统的欧氏距离方法表现更优，且可能改变实证研究的统计推断结论。
en_tdlr: Proposes constructing synthetic controls in Aitchison geometry using centered log-ratio coordinates to better handle compositional outcomes, outperforming traditional Euclidean distance methods when relative incentives determine shares, and potentially altering empirical inference.
